name: WBD Pricing Tables – Gutenberg Pricing Table & Comparison Block
author: wpbranddigital

sections.description:
WBD Pricing Tables is a WordPress pricing table plugin that helps you create professional pricing sections directly in the Gutenberg Block Editor. Display pricing plans, highlight recommended options, list included features, and add call-to-action buttons without writing code.

Live Demos | Pricing | Support

Display your pricing plans, compare available options, highlight recommended plans, and organize product or service features using a customizable pricing table block.

Whether you run a SaaS business, digital agency, startup, freelance service, software website, or online store, WBD Pricing Tables helps you present pricing information in a clear and organized layout without writing custom code.

🚀 Perfect for freelancers, agencies, SaaS, startups, and WooCommerce websites.The plugin provides dedicated Pricing Table functionality and a Comparison Pricing Table block for presenting plans, products, or features in an easy-to-understand format.

Create pricing tables with:

  • Pricing plan names, prices, currency symbols, and billing periods.
  • Descriptions and feature lists for each plan.
  • Call-to-action buttons with custom text and links.
  • Featured or recommended plan styling.
  • Customizable colors and available layout settings.
  • Responsive pricing layouts for different screen sizes.

The plugin also includes a Comparison Pricing Table block for presenting differences between plans, products, services, or features.

✅ Free Features

Free Templates – Add up to 3 pricing plans displayed side by side in a responsive grid.
Customizable Plan Details — Set plan name, price, currency symbol, billing period, and description for each plan.
Feature Lists — Add unlimited features per plan with optional checkmark or cross icons to indicate included/excluded features.
Call-to-Action Buttons — Customize button text and URL for each plan with option to open links in a new tab.
Featured/Recommended Plan — Highlight a plan as “recommended” with a badge and visual emphasis.
Color Customization — Choose header background color, header text color, button color, button text color, and featured plan accent color.
Layout Options — Choose between 1 to 4 columns layout.
Responsive Design — Plans stack gracefully on smaller screens.
Live Preview — See all changes in real time within the editor.

⚡ Pro Version Features

If you need even more features, styling options, or premium support, you can upgrade to the Pro version:

Five Premium Templates
Comparison pricing table block
Advanced Styling & Layout Controls
Priority Support — Dedicated help within 24 hours

Pricing Table and Comparison Blocks

A pricing table presents the price and details of each plan. A comparison table organizes differences between multiple options so visitors can evaluate features more easily.

Depending on your available features, use WBD Pricing Tables to present:

  • Software plans and their included features.
  • Monthly or annual service packages.
  • Agency packages and deliverables.
  • Subscription options.
  • Product features and specifications.
  • Different service levels.

Use descriptive plan names, consistent feature labels, and clear calls to action to make the information easier to understand.

Call-to-Action Buttons

Customize button text and destination URLs for actions such as Get Started, Buy Now, Contact Us, or Learn More. Available settings also allow links to open in a new tab.

Featured or Recommended Plan

Highlight a selected pricing plan with a badge and visual styling to make it stand out.

Why Choose This Pricing Table Block Plugin?

  • Built specifically for Gutenberg (Block Editor)
  • Lightweight and fast loading (better SEO performance)
  • Fully responsive pricing table design
  • No shortcode required – 100% block-based
  • Clean UI inspired by modern SaaS pricing tables

Use Cases

WBD Pricing Tables can be used for:

  • SaaS pricing pages
  • Software pricing plans
  • Service packages
  • Agency pricing
  • Subscription plans
  • Product pricing
  • Product comparison tables
  • Feature comparison sections
  • WooCommerce product-related pricing sections
  • Digital product websites

Comparison Pricing Table Block

Use the Comparison Pricing Table block to organize differences between products, plans, services, or features. A comparison table is useful when visitors need to evaluate several options before choosing one.

For example, you can compare:

  • Software plans and their included features.
  • Service packages and deliverables.
  • Subscription options.
  • Product features.
  • Agency service tiers.

Use clear labels and consistent feature descriptions to make comparisons easier to understand.

Responsive Pricing Layouts

Pricing tables are designed to work across different screen sizes.

Use responsive pricing sections for:

  • SaaS websites
  • Agency websites
  • Service businesses
  • Product websites
  • Subscription websites
  • WooCommerce websites
  • Digital product websites

Lightweight and Performance-Conscious

WBD Pricing Tables focuses on pricing presentation and comparison functionality within Gutenberg.

A focused block-based workflow can help avoid introducing an additional page builder solely to create pricing tables. However, actual page speed depends on your hosting, theme, other plugins, assets, and page content.

For best results, use appropriately sized images elsewhere on the page, avoid unnecessary effects, and test your published page with a performance testing tool.

Accessibility

Help visitors understand your pricing options by using:

  • Clear plan names and pricing information.
  • Descriptive call-to-action labels.
  • Readable text and sufficient color contrast.
  • Consistent feature descriptions.
  • Layouts that remain usable at different screen sizes.

Review your published page with your active theme to check text readability, keyboard usability, link clarity, and responsive behavior.

SEO-Friendly Pricing Sections

WBD Pricing Tables helps you create structured and readable pricing sections using the WordPress Block Editor.

The plugin focuses on:

Clean frontend markup.
Responsive layouts.
Lightweight implementation.
Accessible interactive elements where applicable.
Mobile-friendly pricing sections.
Clear pricing and feature presentation.

The plugin does not replace an SEO plugin. Search engine rankings depend on your overall website content, technical SEO, performance, competition, backlinks, and other factors.

Development

The uncompiled source code for this plugin is fully open-source and publicly accessible.

  • Source Code Repository: https://github.com/wpbranddigital/wbd-pricing-table
  • Source Folder: The human-readable and modifiable source files are included in the /src directory of the plugin.

Build tools and environment:
– Node.js & npm
– webpack
– @wordpress/scripts

To regenerate the compiled files from source:
1. Clone the repository or navigate to the plugin directory.
2. Run npm install to install dependencies.
3. Run npm run build to compile the production assets into the /build directory.
4. Run npm run start to start the development watcher.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for WBD Pricing Tables.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate.
  6. Edit or create a page using the WordPress Block Editor.
  7. Click the + Block Inserter.
  8. Search for Pricing Table.
  9. Add the pricing table block to your page.
  10. Configure your plans, features, buttons, colors, and layout from the Block Inspector.

You can also install the plugin manually:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the plugin ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
How many plans can I add?

You can add up to 6 pricing plans in a single block.

Can I highlight a recommended plan?

Yes! Each plan has a “Featured” toggle that adds a visual badge and elevated styling.

Is the pricing table responsive?

The plugin is designed to display pricing information across different screen sizes. Review your published page on desktop, tablet, and mobile to confirm that the layout works well with your theme.

Does the plugin work with every WordPress theme?

It is designed for the WordPress Block Editor, but the final appearance can vary by theme, global styles, and other plugins. Test your pricing section with your active theme.

Does it process payments or subscriptions?

The plugin presents pricing information and action links. Payment processing and subscription management require an appropriate checkout, payment, or e-commerce solution.
